name: Exp_ColorXvaMA_Digit
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorXvaMA_Digit custom indicator, which applies a double-smoothing approach using two configurable moving average methods. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend and sell positions when it signals a downtrend, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit settings.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorXvaMA_Digit自定义指标进行交易，该指标采用两种可配置平滑方法的双重平滑处理。当指标发出上升趋势信号时开多仓，发出下降趋势信号时开空仓，具有可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈设置。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双重平滑移动平均线的颜色变化信号进行趋势跟踪交易。入场条件：当指标缓冲区1的值为1且前一值小于1时开多仓，当值为0且前一值大于0时开空仓，即检测趋势方向转换的时刻。出场条件：当趋势反向信号出现时平仓（BUY_Close或SELL_Close），同时设有固定的止损和止盈点数。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、亏损自由保证金比例、亏损余额比例和固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode参数决定计算基准。该EA在新K线形成时或需要重新计算时才执行信号检测，避免重复交易。指标使用了XMA（扩展移动平均）双重平滑，第一层为EMA平滑，第二层为JJMA平滑，增强了趋势判断的可靠性。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trend-following trading using color change signals from a double-smoothed moving average indicator. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when indicator buffer 1 equals 1 and the previous value was below 1, and a sell position opens when it equals 0 and the previous value was above 0, detecting moments of trend direction transition. Exit conditions: positions close on reverse trend signals (BUY_Close or SELL_Close), with fixed stop loss and take profit in points. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-free margin percentage, loss-balance percentage, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter for risk ratio and MMMode parameter for calculation basis. The EA only executes signal detection on new bar formation or when recalculation is needed, avoiding duplicate trades. The indicator uses XMA (extended moving average) double smoothing, with the first layer as EMA and the second as JJMA, enhancing trend determination reliability.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，控制每笔交易的风险占比
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio parameter, controls position sizing

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：自由保证金/余额/亏损自由保证金/亏损余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Position sizing mode: free margin/balance/post-loss free margin/post-loss balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosOpen
parameters.description_en: Buy open signal mode: dot signal/direction signal/disabled

parameters.name: SellPosOpen
parameters.description_en: Sell open signal mode: dot signal/direction signal/disabled

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description_en: Price type applied to the indicator

parameters.name: Digit
parameters.description_en: Number of decimal places for indicator display

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于检测信号的K线索引
parameters.description_en: Bar index used to retrieve trading signal

pros: 双重平滑方法（EMA+JJMA）增强了趋势判断的稳定性和灵敏度，减少虚假信号
新K线检测机制避免同一K线内重复交易，减少过度交易风险
支持多种资金管理模式，灵活性高，适应不同交易风格
买卖开关独立控制，可以只做多或只做空，策略配置灵活
有明确的止损止盈设置，风险可控
pros_en: Double smoothing (EMA+JJMA) enhances trend determination stability and sensitivity, reducing false signals
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate trades within the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Multiple money management modes provide high flexibility for different trading styles
Independent buy/sell switches allow long-only or short-only configurations for flexible strategy setup
Explicit stop loss and take profit settings provide controllable risk management
cons: 依赖自定义指标ColorXvaMA_Digit，若指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
没有追踪止损功能，在趋势行情中可能无法充分捕获利润
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利入场
止损和止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动率变化（如ATR），在不同行情下适配性差
没有持仓数量限制，在信号频繁切换时可能产生过多交易
cons_en: Depends on the custom indicator ColorXvaMA_Digit; if the indicator file is missing, the EA cannot run
No trailing stop functionality, potentially failing to capture full profit in trending markets
No spread filter, which may lead to unfavorable entries in high-spread environments
Fixed stop loss and take profit in points do not account for market volatility changes (e.g., ATR), resulting in poor adaptability across different market conditions
No position count limit, which may generate excessive trades when signals switch frequently
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自适应调整止损止盈距离
添加点差过滤和交易时间过滤，避免在不利条件下入场
增加追踪止损功能，在趋势行情中锁定浮盈
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to adaptively adjust distances based on market volatility
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid entries under unfavorable conditions
Add trailing stop functionality to lock in floating profits during trending markets

risk_points: 固定点数止损止盈未考虑市场波动率，在低波动期可能过宽而在高波动期可能过窄
缺少点差过滤，高点差环境下止损可能被频繁触发
双重平滑指标在震荡行情中可能产生频繁虚假信号导致连续亏损
risk_points_en: Fixed point stop loss/take profit does not consider market volatility; may be too wide in low volatility and too narrow in high volatility periods
No spread filter means stop losses may be frequently triggered in high-spread environments
Double smoothing indicator may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
